rules: Real names and logos required by user.
Current entity existence and current faction affiliation are separate facts.
No invented quotes or accusations are attributed to real identities. All generated behavior is simulated.
Corporation and alliance hierarchy must not double-count pilots.
Active roster is not exhaustive. Historical entries are excluded from the default contemporary roster.
Current CEO is a sourced organizational role; tactical FC ability is not inferred.
